description: Unleash feature-flag connector. Surfaces feature-flag definitions across all Unleash projects — name, type, description, project, stale state, tags, per-environment enabled state, and timestamps — for indexing as `unleash:feature_flag` items, useful for incident correlation ("was this flag on when the alert fired?"). Admin API auth with an admin or personal access token sent as the bare `Authorization: <token>` header. Unleash is usually self-hosted: the instance URL is required (`UNLEASH_API_URL`, https only, plain http only to a loopback host) and has no default, so the static sandbox network list is intentionally empty and the host is added at spawn time. Per-environment strategies are read live with `unleash_feature_state_get`. Write tool (needs owner approval): `unleash.feature.toggle` turns a feature on or off in ONE environment; reversible by toggling back; Unleash refuses it while change requests are enabled.
